text.p: Slovenian shares extended their losing streak into the ninth consecutive session on Tuesday amid low liquidity.
Traders said small investors were selling shares ahead of the summer holiday season while potential buyers were holding off in the expectation of further price falls.
* The SBI index fell 0.74 percent or 8.86 points to 1,190.30.
* Drug maker Lek had the highest turnover, falling 1.59 percent to 21,650 tolars on volume of 782 shares, for total turnover of 16.6 million.
* Lek's issue C led decliners, tumbling 6.71 percent to 21,000 tolars on volume of only one share. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
